issues.original: Quisquis forte sua contentus, ianthina gestet,
issues.current: Whoever … wears violet, let him bear / quiconque … porte le violet, supporte
issues.suggested: gestet — повелительное к довольному судьбой, ferat — второй субъект (как в RU): EN «Let whoever is content with his lot wear violet, and whoever bears Fortune's troubles calmly»; FR «Que quiconque est content de son sort porte le violet, ainsi que celui qui supporte…»
